title: cemkit error code
description: REL-002 failure code, stored by name. Generated by scripts/gen_error_codes.py from kernel/cemkit/core/error.hpp; do not edit. x-cemkit-code is the fixed integer used across the C ABI.

oneOf.description: The spec failed validation and was not compiled.
The stated requirements cannot be met together, or not by the selected product family.
A model was asked for a value outside its stated validity range; no number is returned.
Geometry generation failed or produced an invalid solid.
Meshing failed or the mesh did not pass its quality checks.
A simulation ran but its result did not pass the trust gate.
A job exceeded its memory, time or disk budget.
An argument was malformed or outside its domain (for example NaN, a negative uncertainty or a malformed version string).
A unit in the input is not one the spec compiler recognises.
A value's unit has the wrong dimension for the field it was given for.
A defect in cemkit itself; it should be reported and fixed.

A capability the spec declares (a requested family or a hook of that family) is not provided by this release; the details name it under capability. Never a placeholder for unfinished code; no value is returned.
